objects.parameters: integers r>=1 and j>=1, m=2r+1, ell=10mj; any positive finite rational Ising parameters u,v
objects.configuration_x: Constant along rows; cyclic column word +^m -^(3m) +^(3m) -^(3m), repeated j times
objects.configuration_y: Constant along rows; cyclic column word +^(2m) -^(3m) +^(2m) -^(3m), repeated j times
objects.same_record: Histogram of every radius-r square spin-neighborhood pattern; consequently magnetization, energy, all shorter local counts, and the count F of all-plus m-by-m windows agree
objects.outside_actual_target: Both have plus density 2/5, hence negative magnetization
objects.diagnostic: The total physical rate of a jump decreasing F by exactly m
objects.finite_time_separation: Let d=(m-2)j q4/ell=(m-2)q4/(10m) and t=d/(2 ell^2). Total variation between the two laws of F_t is at least d^2/4, and hence at least q4^2/3600. A predictor that knows only the common initial histogram has worst-case TV error at least q4^2/7200.
objects.failed_claim: The complete histogram of bounded-radius spin patterns is an exact Markov state for finite-temperature square-lattice heat-bath dynamics
objects.scope: Strong lumpability and compressed short-time prediction. No first-passage lower bound from all-minus, no significant-current assertion for these stripe states, no lower bound for richer representations or unrestricted algorithms.

objects.limiting_law: tau/E tau converges to a shape-2 Erlang variable divided by 2, not Exp(1)
objects.failed_claim: Rare capacity and a perfectly equilibrated source core alone justify the full exponential waiting-time law
objects.scope: Finite reversible ordered birth-death processes. No Ising embedding or assertion about the actual two-dimensional model is claimed.
